SELECT c.productid ,p.categoryid ,p.pnm ,p.title ,DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.cont, 200, 1) as cont ,p.qty as pqty ,c.qty
,TRUNC(p.price * 0.9) as price ,TRUNC(p.price * 0.9) * c.qty subtot
,p.price ,p.price * c.qty subtot
,u.usrnm ,g.imgnm FROM P_CART c JOIN products p ON c.productid = p.productid JOIN USERS u ON u.usrno = c.usrno LEFT JOIN P_GALLERY g ON p.productid = g.productid WHERE u.usrno = #{usrno}
